class.name: WeaponSimulationSettings
class.brief_description: Editable firearm timing and magazine configuration.
class.description: Used by [WeaponSimulation]. Configuration copies these values into each runtime. Durations are rounded up to whole simulation ticks; changing this Resource does not alter an already configured weapon. Reserve ammunition belongs to the owning game. Invalid authored values are reported by [method validation_errors] and rejected by [method WeaponSimulation.configure].

method.name: validation_errors
method.description: Returns validation errors, or an empty array when all values are valid.
